summary_brief: 今日全球 AI 工程生态呈现三大主线：一是 Agent 长会话上下文管理成为集体攻坚焦点，多个项目同步推进上下文压缩、增量工具目录与资源护栏；二是安全加固全面铺开，涉及 MCP 凭据隔离、pre-bash 阻断语义修复、SSRF 防护与 XSS 收敛；三是多 provider 适配与模型生态扩张加速，Cohere/Gemini/Groq/Bedrock 原生通道持续整合，语音多模态能力进入主流 SDK。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 长会话上下文管理与资源护栏成为集体攻坚焦点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多家项目在同期针对长会话上下文膨胀问题推出系统性方案——包括上下文压缩标准化、增量工具目录、输出大小上限与指标基数治理，标志着 Agent 框架从'能用'向'长跑稳定'的成熟阶段演进。

engineering_signals.title: 安全加固全面铺开：MCP 凭据隔离、Hook 阻断语义与沙箱逃逸防护
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目同期修复高危安全漏洞，包括 MCP 请求目标钉死防止凭据外泄、pre-bash 拒绝改用阻断退出码、SSRF 覆盖浏览器连接、reflection 绕过阻断与 Telegram 授权默认拒绝，体现 Agent 通用安全基线的集体收紧。

engineering_signals.title: 多模型 Provider 生态加速整合：原生通道与能力抽象化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cohere、Gemini、Groq、Bedrock 等多家供应商被整合为原生 provider 而非依赖 AI SDK 封装，并通过 capabilities 字段将联网搜索、远程压缩等能力抽象为可配置项，标志多模型接入从'适配'走向'一等公民'。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 编排运行时迈向持久化权威状态与托管工作流
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 命令注册表 + 追加式事件日志的任务控制运行时、托管 worktree 工具化、Foundry 云端工作流托管、Job 生命周期探索等共同指向 Agent 编排从'临时执行'向'可恢复、可审计、可托管'的系统化演进。

engineering_signals.title: 多模态交互能力进入主流 Agent 工具：语音与富媒体成标配
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Python SDK 新增自定义语音与 Agent 会话事件、OpenHands 加入语音听写、OpenClaw 支持 YouTube 内联播放等，表明语音与富媒体交互正从演示性功能走向正式 SDK 能力与产品级支持。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 协议互操作性与容错性集体增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: MCP 瞬态连接重试、SSE 挂起修复、MCPClientError 类型化导出、MCP 目录延迟加载稳定性与安全标签动态工具应用等多项改进同期出现，反映 MCP 正从'能连'走向'稳健可靠'的协议成熟阶段。

engineering_signals.title: Web 全栈基础设施性能与稳定性密集优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Next.js/Turborepo 针对 Suspense 误触发、浅更新挂起、模块缓存 Map 化、esm getter 导出优化等深层链路进行密集修复，同时涉及文档同步、抓取重试、缓存命中等多个工程链路，体现核心 Web 基础层的持续打磨。

engineering_signals.title: 知识库/文档同步能力系统化补强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 同时推进 Mintlify 站点完整同步修复、文档抓取重试退避、知识同步 AgentOS 生命周期与流式进度上报，将知识库同步从'尽力而为'升级为'可观测、可取消、可恢复'的工程化能力。

engineering_signals.title: AI 编码工具向系统化控制台与插件化驾驶舱演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo 大版本聚合多个能力（Missions 规划器、插件市场、调色板）、Cline 桌面引入 Connectors 中心、CLI 插件化 Mod API 迁移等，共同指向 AI 编码交互从单页工具向集成化、可扩展的开发者控制台形态演进。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 会话可观测性与决策一致性评估成为标配
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: BYOK 观测追踪、Guardian 决策对齐指标、运行时当前模型暴露、ACP 压缩进度标准化上报等多项能力，指向 Agent 从'黑盒执行'向'可观测、可审计、可对齐评估'的信任基础设施演进。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 插件系统大规模修复与增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 连续两个补丁版本（v2.1.288/v2.1.289）包含大量针对插件、Mods、MCP 生态的修复与增强，表明 Claude Code 正在快速迭代其扩展生态，为开发者提供更稳定、更安全的插件开发体验。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 安全模型强化
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了多个安全漏洞，包括绕过 Bash deny/ask 规则、通过符号链接绕过 Read 规则、以及危险的 rm 命令在 bypassPermissions 模式下可无提示执行等问题，显著提升了工具在受管环境下的安全性。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 会话恢复与稳定性提升
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了 --resume 功能可能丢失文件、上下文、模型思考过程等问题，并解决了长对话自动压缩失败、超时处理不当等稳定性问题，提升了用户长时间工作流体验。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 新增 UI 与交互特性
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 $.ui.selection() API、Ctrl+F 会话搜索、Alt+方向键切换分组、Ctrl+C 后恢复提示草稿等特性，提升了全屏模式和代理视图下的用户交互效率。

release_signals.title: Cline 桌面版引入 Connectors 中心
release_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 桌面版将 Connectors 作为默认标签页，并新增浏览、搜索、建议组合等功能，标志着其从简单的 MCP 市场向更全面的连接器生态管理平台演进。

release_signals.title: Cline 云会话模型支持扩展
release_signals.why_it_matters: 云会话现在支持 Cline Usage-Billing、ClinePass、ClineFree 等更多模型选项，并优化了模型选择流程，增强了云服务的灵活性和可用性。

release_signals.title: Cline Agent 团队性能优化
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了 Agent 团队在长会话和流式传输中因重复保存整个团队状态而导致的性能下降和数据库文件膨胀问题，通过压缩和增量写入机制显著提升了性能。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Python SDK 新增语音与代理功能
release_signals.why_it_matters: v3.24.0 新增自定义语音创建和代理会话事件支持，扩展了 SDK 在语音和代理场景下的能力。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK 沙箱与安全增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: v0.23.0 引入了 Docker 移除保护、加密历史扫描预算、内存整合轮次配置等多项沙箱和会话安全特性，并修复了大量与工具调用、流式处理、会话持久化相关的安全问题。

release_signals.title: Microsoft Agent Framework 重大更新
release_signals.why_it_matters: v1.20.0 新增 Foundry 托管、DuckDB/SQL Server/TypeSafe 向量存储连接器、原生计算机使用支持等，并对 Foundry 托管和声明式工作流进行了破坏性重构，是功能丰富的重要版本。

release_signals.title: ruflo 转型为 Claude Code Mod
release_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo 从传统的 shell 命令钩子迁移到 Claude Code 的 Mod API，实现了进程内路由和工具检查，性能提升显著（0.045ms vs 18.2ms），代表了 AI 工具集成方式的演进方向。

release_signals.title: ruflo 发布安全补丁
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了 PreToolUse 钩子中命令拒绝无效（exit 1 而非 exit 2）的安全漏洞，以及 MCP 工具可能向未配置的服务发送凭据的问题，对使用该工具的用户至关重要。

release_signals.title: OpenClaw 发布扩展稳定版
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenClaw 发布 2026.8.35 扩展稳定版（LTS 等价物），包含 GPT-6.1 Sol 模型支持、关键安全更新、可靠性修复和性能优化，为生产环境用户提供稳定基线。

release_signals.title: OpenClaw 常规版本发布
release_signals.why_it_matters: 2026.9.8 版本包含 58 个提交和 43 个 PR，由 21 位贡献者共同完成，体现了项目的活跃度和持续迭代能力。

release_signals.title: Agno 知识库页面同步增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: v3.1.1 为知识库页面同步添加了实时进度、取消支持、失败页面报告和重试机制，并修复了大型 Mintlify 站点的同步问题，提升了知识库管理的可靠性和可观测性。

release_signals.title: Fabric 修复二进制名模式回退问题
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了当模式从二进制名派生时错误提示不清晰的问题，并引入了更明确的错误提示和 i18n 支持，提升了用户体验。

release_signals.title: Turborepo 修复环境变量与缓存问题
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了 SDKROOT 传递和 Vercel OIDC token 轮换影响缓存的问题，属于对现有功能的稳定性修复。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Fixed a deny or ask rule on a nested part of a compound shell command not holding over a user-installed mod's approval on managed machines
- Fixed the terminal freezing on short code blocks with many unclosed `<script>` tags or deeply nested `${` substitutions
- Fixed `Read` deny rules not applying to files @-mentioned, changed, or selected in the IDE through a symlink
- [VSCode] Reverted a 2.1.288 change to `claude auth status` that may have made sign-outs more frequent
- Improved how quickly large files open in a plugin code pane by laying the highlighted view out once at its final width
- Fixed `plugin list`, `plugin eval` and `plugin update` showing a stale copy of a plugin installed from a local folder marketplace, and hot reload for a symlinked `--plugin-dir`
- Fixed installed mods not loading in the first session after an upgrade
- Fixed a plugin's rows above the prompt showing a stale row while the Background tasks dialog was open in fullscreen
- Fixed plugin panes drawing nothing when a link used a localhost address, an `@` in its path, an uppercase host or a `file:` path
- Fixed a user-installed plugin being able to rewrite the descriptions of an organization-managed MCP server's sign-in tools
- Fixed a freeze or forced quit at launch when a plugin drew a Box with a border style the terminal does not know
- Fixed supervised and background sessions ending when a plugin's on-screen handler threw asynchronously
- Fixed sessions ending with an interface error when a plugin region with no height kept growing
- Fixed Bash deny and ask rules missing a command behind an environment variable prefix with an expanded value (e.g. `TZ="$HOME" rm -rf build`) when the sandbox auto-allows commands
- Fixed a Bash deny or ask rule being skipped under sandbox auto-allow when a bare variable assignment came before the command
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` skipping the plugin when the folder also holds a marketplace manifest
- Added `agent.spawn` for teammates, one agent id across plugin hook events, and idle and waiting states in `$.agent.list()`
- Fixed sessions ending with "unrecoverable interface error" when a value a mod's `ui.render` hook wrote made a row throw while drawn; the engine now draws its own row instead
- Fixed text with a tab, a stray escape and a C1 control, or a short text with a tab and CRLF line endings, drawing over the rows below it
- Fixed right-aligned content in a mod's pane or band drawing under the close mark or `[-]`, which now also keep one column in from the terminal's edge
- Fixed a mod's `Client` that fails while drawn taking down everything the mod drew around it; it now fails alone and raises `ui.fault`
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` failing an Anthropic marketplace's own plugin and listing a clean `plugin.json` in `--json`
- Fixed a mod's band that fails to draw briefly telling the cards under it to step aside
- Fixed a failed plugin component showing `Error` or nothing as its reason when the failure carried no message
- Improved the line a mod's author sees when its band or pane fails to draw: it names the mod and says nothing was drawn
- Fixed published artifact pages freezing or crashing the reader's browser tab on short code blocks with many unclosed `<script>` tags
- Fixed a mod's Client region staying failed for the whole session after the terminal threw while drawing it

key_changes: 修复了多个导致终端冻结、崩溃或异常退出的问题，包括短代码块中的未闭合 <script> 标签、深层嵌套的 ${ 替换、未知边框样式及异步异常等场景
修复了 Bash deny/ask 规则在环境变量前缀或裸变量赋值场景下被跳过的问题，以及 Read 拒绝规则不适用于通过符号链接 @引用文件的问题
修复了插件相关的多项问题，包括列表显示过期副本、视图绘制不完整、模态框行绘制异常及会话误终止等
新增 agent.spawn 供队友使用，支持跨插件钩子事件的统一 agent ID，并在 $.agent.list() 中提供空闲和等待状态
回退了 VSCode 中 2.1.288 版本对 claude auth status 的变更，以减少频繁登出问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本以修复为主，集中解决了大量终端稳定性问题（冻结、崩溃、异常退出）以及安全和权限规则（Bash deny/ask、Read deny）未正确生效的场景。同时修复了插件和 mod 相关的多项显示与运行问题，包括旧副本显示、绘制不完整、会话误终止等。此外还引入了一个新功能：agent.spawn 供队友使用，并提供统一的 agent ID 及 idle/waiting 状态查询。

releases.summary:
## Changes

### PR [#2173](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2173) by [OdinKral](https://github.com/OdinKral) and [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): fix: clearer error when binary name used as pattern fallback

- Added a clearer error hint when a pattern is derived from the binary name, explaining that the executable name was used as a fallback and how to specify a pattern explicitly with `-p`.
- Introduced a `patternFromBinaryName()` helper and explicit tracking of binary-derived pattern names during flag initialization, so fallback hints appear only when a pattern truly came from the binary name.
- Prevented `fabric-ai` from automatically selecting a pattern by binary name by centralizing the list of executable names that do not trigger pattern selection.
- Added the `pattern_from_binary_name_hint` key with localized text across all ten non-English locale files for a consistent i18n bundle.
- Simplified error wrapping, removed obsolete detection tests, and added coverage for default executable exclusion and extension-stripped pattern selection.

### Direct commits

- Merge branch 'main' into docs/sync-chinese-readme

key_changes: 当模式从可执行文件名回退派生时，提供更清晰的错误提示，并说明如何通过 -p 参数显式指定模式
新增 patternFromBinaryName() 辅助函数，精确追踪模式是否来自二进制名称，确保只在真实回退时显示提示
集中管理不触发模式选择的可执行文件名列表，防止 fabric-ai 自动按二进制名选择模式
新增 pattern_from_binary_name_hint 键，并同步更新十个非英语语言环境的本地化文件
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次更新修复了二进制名称被用作模式回退时错误提示不清晰的问题。通过新增辅助函数和集中管理可执行文件名列表，确保用户在使用默认名称时获得明确的引导提示，并知晓如何通过 -p 参数指定模式。同时完善了多语言本地化支持。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `$.ui.selection()` for mods: returns the text you last selected in fullscreen mode and, when the selection lies within one transcript row, that row
- Added a built-in `gh api` to cloud sessions whose image has no GitHub CLI, and fixed the built-in sending control characters from file names, jq filters or GitHub errors to the terminal
- Added recovery for a prompt cleared with Ctrl+C: pressing Up on the empty prompt brings the draft back, including pasted text and images
- Added a re-authenticate prompt when an MCP server asks for more OAuth scope during a tool call
- Added `--max-findings <n>|all` to /code-review to report more or fewer findings than the usual limit; the choice is reused until you pass `--max-findings default`
- Added Ctrl+F to find a session by name and Alt+↑/↓ to jump between groups in the agents view; both, and rename, can be rebound in keybindings.json
- Added a screen reader mode announcement of the new permission mode when you approve a plan, including with Shift+Tab
- Fixed mid-response API timeouts failing the turn: non-interactive sessions and subagents now continue from the partial response, and thinking-only responses are retried
- Fixed long conversations failing with "Prompt is too long" instead of auto-compacting when the last reply reported zero token usage
- Fixed `--resume` sometimes dropping files and other context that a compaction had just restored
- Fixed a resumed session sometimes not saving the last response of a turn, so that the next `--resume` showed the prompt unanswered
- Fixed resume occasionally loading a transcript cut short when the same session rewrote the file during the load
- Fixed resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier dropping the model's earlier thinking
- Fixed session titles, memory recall and prompt hooks failing on Mantle or behind gateways that reject structured outputs; added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS` to turn structured outputs off
- Fixed auto mode denials pointing Claude at a Bash permission rule when the blocked tool was not Bash
- Fixed auto mode on Bedrock and Mantle switching to the local classifier for the rest of the session after a request to an older model, such as a WebFetch summary or a `sonnet` subagent
- Fixed cloud sessions that restarted on a newly picked model replying with that model after the server refused it
- Fixed Cowork cloud sessions staying marked as waiting for input after a WebFetch permission prompt for an unapproved URL went unanswered for five minutes
- Fixed prompt suggestions not appearing on a phone that joins a Cowork cloud session started on another device
- Fixed a mod's button sometimes running a different button's action when pressed on a view drawn before Claude Code restarted
- Fixed a plugin's pane showing nothing when one `Code` element held a diff that does not parse; it now draws as plain code
- Fixed plugin LSP servers receiving literal `${user_config.*}` and `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` placeholders in `initializationOptions` and `settings` instead of substituted values or manifest defaults
- Fixed a plugin's `tool.call` hook making Bash fail and file searches read the wrong folder in subagents that run in a worktree
- Fixed `git-subdir` plugin installs failing, or caching an incomplete plugin, on older git (before 2.39, e.g. Ubuntu 22.04's 2.34)
- Fixed plugins loaded with `--plugin-dir` not showing "Configure options" in `/plugin`
- Fixed background sessions ending when a plugin was reloaded or disabled while one of its timers or reads was still running
- Fixed sandboxed heredocs with an unquoted delimiter (`python3 <<EOF`) asking for approval on every run under sandbox auto-allow when the body holds only plain text and simple `$VAR` references
- Fixed Bash tool permission check to prompt before a `BASHPID` assignment whose value the shell would evaluate as arithmetic, instead of allowing it silently
- Fixed fullscreen sessions exiting with "unrecoverable interface error" when opening the background tasks dialog while a plugin or mod showed rows above the prompt
- Fixed Claude reporting a message to another session as delivered when that session held it: the notice now says it wasn't delivered and names the session, and in SDK sessions Claude can now learn of it mid-turn
- Fixed OpenTelemetry `claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user` spans reporting `unknown` source or decision in `-p` and SDK sessions and for PreToolUse hook approvals
- Fixed permission asks that ended unanswered, in `-p` or on an interrupted turn, emitting no `tool_decision` event
- Fixed Edit and Retry in Cowork cloud sessions refusing a message sent before `/compact` even though its history was still saved
- Fixed unattended sessions (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) retrying for hours after a very long response stream failed; Claude Code now streams again, and gives up after three timeouts
- Fixed `/login` reporting "Login successful" when credentials could not be saved to secure storage; it now shows the failure, and offers a retry when the new login didn't take effect (anthropics/claude-code#73861)
- Fixed a Stop during Bedrock credential lookup sometimes moving the session to a fallback model instead of ending the request
- Fixed a second `gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh` browser sign-in opening when a laptop wakes from sleep while another Claude Code process is signing in
- Fixed agent teams: a plugin-defined agent spawned by name now runs with its own prompt, tools, disallowedTools and effort instead of the defaults
- Fixed headless (`-p` / SDK) sessions occasionally ignoring SIGTERM when a supervisor such as `timeout` or systemd sends SIGCONT alongside it
- Fixed restarted cloud sessions restoring a model that the organization's enforced model list refuses
- Fixed MCP tool calls sometimes running twice when a remote server's result was over 16 MB or could not be parsed
- Fixed subagents in Claude Desktop's Code tab getting none of the tools of a user-configured MCP server named `memory`
- Fixed Claude in Chrome asking before every screenshot and page read on a site you allowed when auto mode is unavailable (such as with `disableAutoMode` or an older model); typing, navigation and JavaScript still ask
- Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for GitHub-source plugins on macOS and Linux machines with no GitHub SSH key: the clone now falls back to HTTPS and prints a notice
- Fixed `sandbox.credentials.files` entries on git config files not taking effect while `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` is on
- Fixed Claude leaving out your organization's design systems when starting slides or a design with the Artifact tool on Team and Enterprise plans or machines with managed settings
- Fixed the keyboard not working on Windows after Claude Code restarts itself (first sign-in to a Claude apps gateway, provider setup, `/tui`)
- Fixed a stall when launching an agent whose `tools:` lists very many `Agent(...)` entries
- Fixed sessions on Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3 Sonnet failing on every turn after a whole PDF entered the conversation
- Fixed the npm auto-updater reporting success when the platform-native binary failed to download and only the placeholder `claude` stub was installed
- Fixed Remote Control cleanup archiving a session that is still connected or was just re-attached by another Claude Code process
- Fixed `owner/repo` plugin marketplaces showing only the second attempt's error when both the SSH and HTTPS fetch fail; both errors are now shown, with the transport tried first on top
- Fixed path-scoped `.claude/rules` and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading when Write or Edit creates or changes a file in their scope (previously only Read loaded them)
- Fixed a dangerous `rm` (such as one on `/` or the home directory) inside a `bash -c` or `sh -c` script running without a prompt in bypassPermissions mode or under a shell allow rule (anthropics/claude-code#96300)
- Fixed LSP tool calls hanging indefinitely when a language server uses dynamic capability registration or stops responding; requests now time out after 60s (per-server `requestTimeout`)
- Fixed `idle_prompt` notification hooks firing while background agents are still running (anthropics/claude-code#93672)
- Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks being skipped when matching them failed or the tool's input could not be serialized to JSON; the call is now blocked
- Fixed the first request in a fresh environment or after a model switch using the built-in output limit and auto-compact window, not the server's; that request may now wait up to 1.5 seconds
- Fixed the "What should Claude do instead?" hint showing on the Interrupted row after sending queued messages with ctrl+enter
- Fixed `/login` in a `--bare` session running a sign-in the session never reads, which could replace your saved login; it now says which credentials work
- Fixed the InstructionsLoaded hook omitting agent_id and agent_type when a subagent's file access loads a rule or nested CLAUDE.md; rules and nested CLAUDE.md files loaded on file access now also report effort
- Fixed the Agent tool in `claude mcp serve` always reporting no available agents and rejecting every subagent_type
- Fixed the terminal cursor not following the typed text in the fullscreen transcript viewer's search and in `/theme`'s custom color search
- Fixed `/permissions` in screen reader mode: typing a rule's number now picks it instead of opening the search box
- Improved auto mode: when a conversation grows too long for the client-side safety classifier to review, it is now compacted instead of prompting for, or failing, every tool call
- Improved screen reader mode: short announcements, such as a deleted word, now stay on screen until your next key press or until something above them on screen changes
- Improved screen reader mode: answered questions in question dialogs now say "answered" beside their box
- Improved the `/usage-credits` message shown to Team and Enterprise members whose organization has turned off usage credit requests
- Improved cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits for a stdio MCP server whose config sets `alwaysLoad: false`
- Improved "You should know" notes to say "we", "the main agent" or "you" depending on who was responsible for a decision
- Improved the error for an artifact database write refused at the database's size limit: it now states the limit and what frees space
- Improved Bash permission prompts to give a shorter reason when part of a command can't be checked before it runs
- Self-hosted runner: Improved the built-in `gh api`: a refused gh command now prints its `gh api` equivalent, `--paginate` follows every page of a repository's lists, and a nested `claude` no longer removes it
- Improved Remote Control's recovery from an expired server credential: sessions stay connected during renewal and are kept if it gives up after a server outage
- Changed the background command time limit to apply only in unattended sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK, CI, cloud); terminal, desktop app and VS Code sessions have no limit
- Changed the client-side auto mode classifier to ignore an `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` pin that names Claude Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 and use Claude Sonnet 5 instead
- Changed `claude project purge` to `claude purge`; the old name still works and prints a notice
- Changed the agents view `n:` filter (and Ctrl+F search) so Enter opens the session whose name matches best instead of the top row
- Changed `/autocompact` to save the auto-compact window per model, so each model keeps its own setting when you switch
- Changed MCP URL prompts from servers that can't report when you're done to wait for "I'm done, continue" before the tool call continues, so you can finish in the browser first
- [VSCode] Fixed a claude.ai connector staying on "Needs authentication" after you authorize it: the MCP servers dialog now offers Check connection
- [VSCode] Fixed the opt-in New Conversation shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+N) starting a conversation in every visible Claude view instead of only the one you are in
- [VSCode] Fixed the chat view resuming the next saved session after you archive the one it shows; it now starts a new conversation instead
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Cloud sessions switch in Claude Code admin settings staying locked off while an unrelated security setting was loading or had failed to load
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed pressing Stop while a self-hosted runner was still starting not cancelling the queued message, which could then run once the runner was up
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin settings offering a "Remove this scope" option, which always failed, on channels whose settings were created automatically
- [Claude Tag] Improved Claude to also follow a related Slack thread in another channel that it only read, so updates there reach the conversation that depends on them
- [Claude Tag] Improved save errors on a channel's Configure page: too-long channel instructions now say to shorten them, and a save refused for lost access no longer says to try again

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
- Agent teams no longer slow down as a session runs or while a teammate is streaming. Every streamed chunk and 2-second heartbeat used to re-save the whole team state, including every finished teammate's full transcript (one local `teams.db` reached 1.66 GB, with a single run row rewritten ~339k times). Stream chunks and heartbeats now go to live UIs only and are never persisted, only changed entities are written (batched into one transaction every ~300 ms), run records keep a summary instead of the transcript, and `team_events` is capped per team (2000 rows, 30 days). SQLite team storage moves to schema v2 with a one-time migration that compacts existing data; `SqliteTeamStore.vacuum()` returns the freed space when called explicitly. Failed team writes are retried instead of dropped
- Standalone provider requests made outside a session (such as commit message generation) can now resolve Cline surface headers. `sessionId` is optional in `resolveProviderRequestHeaders`, and `X-Task-ID` is omitted rather than sent empty
- Refreshed the model catalog. Default models change for DigitalOcean (GPT-6.1 Sol), GMI Cloud (Qwen 3.8 Flash), NanoGPT (Pareto 26.10 Preview), Nvidia (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash), and Ofox (GPT-6.1 Sol)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.89...sdk/sdk/v0.0.90

key_changes: 修复 Agent 团队会话运行时的性能瓶颈：流式数据块和心跳信号不再持久化，仅实时发送到 UI，消除了每次重写整个团队状态的开销
SQLite 团队存储升级到 schema v2，通过一次性迁移压缩现有数据，记录条目改为保存摘要而非完整转录，team_events 表每个团队限制为 2000 行/30 天
团队写入失败时自动重试而非直接丢弃，写入变更批量合并为每约 300ms 一次事务
会话外的独立 Provider 请求（如生成提交消息）现在可解析 Cline surface headers，sessionId 变为可选项，X-Task-ID 不再发送空值
刷新了模型目录，多家云服务商的默认模型发生变更（DigitalOcean、GMI Cloud、NanoGPT、Nvidia、Ofox）
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本重点优化了 Agent 团队模式的性能，解决了长时间会话导致的状态膨胀问题（原团队数据库可达 1.66 GB），通过不持久化流式数据、批量事务写入和记录精简等手段大幅减少了 I/O 开销。同时改进了会话外 Provider 请求的 header 解析能力，并更新了模型目录中多家服务商的默认模型。

releases.summary:
# Changelog

## New Features

- Live progress & cancellation for page sync: `Knowledge.stream_sync_pages()` / `astream_sync_pages()` yield typed `PageSyncProgress` snapshots plus one terminal `SyncReport`, and `sync_pages` / `async_sync_pages` accept an `on_progress` observer. A workflow function step can now yield `StepProgress(content=..., data=...)` before its `StepOutput`, emitted as a native `StepProgressEvent` under the existing workflow run/step ID — AgentOS streams it over the existing workflow REST/SSE route, and `AgentOSClient.run_workflow_stream()` parses it. Cancelling a sync now actually reaches the work instead of draining to the end. (#10098)
- Page sync reports name failed pages: `SyncReport.failed_paths` lists the site paths of pages that failed to publish/delete (capped at the first 20, like `errors`; `failed` keeps the full count; defaults to `()` so existing callers/stored reports are unaffected). Logs now name the page and its cause chain, e.g. `Page sync failed for /guides/setup.md (SyncFailed: sync_failed <- ConnectError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer)`, plus a new `Page delete failed for …` warning on the prune path. (#10729)

## Bug Fixes

- Retry transient page-fetch failures with backoff: on large corpora (e.g. [docs.agno.com](http://docs.agno.com/), 3,913 pages) 1–2 random pages failed per run with `Connection reset by peer`. Each attempt previously consumed the entire 30s fetch deadline (leaving no time to retry) and retries were too short — both are fixed with a bounded per-attempt timeout and backoff. (#10730)
- Complete page sync for Mintlify-style sites: large Mintlify sites (e.g. [docs.langchain.com](http://docs.langchain.com/)) synced as `partial` even when every page indexed — and a `partial` result skips pruning, so removed pages stayed searchable indefinitely. Discovery now skips links to non-page files (`.json`, `.yaml`, `.xml`, `.csv`, `.pdf`, images/audio/video, archives, fonts — while keeping `.js`/`.css` as valid page names like `/guides/node.js`), and handles nested indexes, MDX code blocks and redirect aliases. Off-host page links still block pruning (by design). (#10726)

## What's Changed
* feat: name failed pages and their causes in page sync reports by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10729
* fix: retry transient page fetch failures with backoff by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10730
* feat: add AgentOS lifecycle support for Knowledge page synchronization by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10098
* fix: complete page sync for Mintlify-style sites (non-page links, nested indexes, MDX code, redirect aliases) by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10726
* chore: Release v3.1.1 by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10736


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/compare/v3.1.0...v3.1.1

releases.summary:
Security patch for `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` (`latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha` → 3.51.1). Upgrading is recommended.

**PreToolUse `pre-bash` denials now block (#3623).** When the hook handler recognised a denied command, it exited with status 1. Claude Code treats that as a non-blocking hook error, so the command could still run. Denials now exit 2, the status Claude Code's PreToolUse uses to block. The fix covers both shipped `hook-handler.cjs` copies and the handler `ruflo init` generates. Existing projects pick it up with `npx ruflo@latest init upgrade` (or a helper refresh).

**MCP tools send credentials only to configured services (#3624).** `x_federation_*` and `seraphina_guidance` read env-only credentials (`RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_KEY`). Their destinations are now pinned to the server-configured HTTPS base (`RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_URL`). A URL tool argument is only an assertion that must match that base; an absent, null or empty argument means no assertion. Every credential-bearing request rejects redirects. Operator configuration may name a loopback HTTP service for local or self-hosted gateways.

Verified: signed helper manifest at 3.51.1, witness manifests 117/117 on linux, macOS and Windows. A fresh `npx ruflo@3.51.1 init` writes the exit-2 handler.

key_changes: 安全补丁：修复 @claude-flow/cli、claude-flow 和 ruflo 多个版本链的安全漏洞，建议升级
PreToolUse pre-bash 拒绝逻辑修复：denials 从退出码 1 改为 2，确保被拒绝的命令真正被阻止执行
MCP 工具凭据安全加固：x_federation_* 和 seraphina_guidance 只向服务端配置的 HTTPS 基地址发送凭据，并拒绝所有重定向请求

releases.summary:
## ruflo 3.50.0: ruflo as a Claude Code mod

Install with `npx ruflo@latest`; `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` are all at 3.50.0.

Claude Code mods let a plugin hook the engine directly, as in-process TypeScript functions instead of shell commands. This release brings ruflo onto that API. It is **opt-in**: the classic hooks stay the default and the automatic fallback, and ruflo behaves exactly as before when function hooks are off.

### What's new
- **`ruflo mods install | uninstall | status | doctor | sync-policy`** and **`ruflo init --mods`** (ADR-404, #3608). Install writes only project-scoped files (`.claude/settings.local.json`, `.claude-flow/mods/install.json`).
- **The `ruflo-mods` plugin:**
  - **Routing:** in-process prompt routing, byte-identical to the classic `route` hook. In-process it takes 0.045 ms median versus 18.2 ms for a spawned hook.
  - **`tool.check`:** fed by ruflo policy, and it only ever tightens a verdict.
  - **Also:** edit learning signals, the cost budget ladder, and a status bar.
  - **`$.ruflo` noun:** `segment`, `lastRoute` and `snapshot`, so other mods (ruOS among them) can add to ruflo's status bar instead of drawing their own.
  - **Mod trust gate:** for mods loaded mid-session, including ones Claude writes. It only observes by default; `refuse-risky` is opt-in, and the allow-list matches the install source, not a self-declared name.
- **The `ruflo-swarm` pane mod 0.3.0** (#3607): a live pane with one tile per agent, which light up as agents read and write. It also shows the topology, the task and claims board, cost and tokens, the router's pick and hive-mind votes, and has buttons that act through the ruflo CLI. Claude Code subagents appear as tiles.
- **`ruflo-ruos`** (ADR-405, #3605): run swarm agents on your own ruOS cloud desktops.
  - **Transport:** only the tenant-authenticated fleet MCP and the ruOS jobs API (ADR-105). The unauthenticated desktop executor port is never used.
  - **Live run:** a live run on a real desktop passed, and the desktop was stopped and verified afterwards.
- **`ruflo-plugin-creator` 0.3.0:** a `create-mod` skill and template for scaffolding governed mods.

### Requirements and caveats
- Requires Claude Code **2.1.287 or newer**, where mods are on by default. Versions 2.1.277–2.1.286 need `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1`.
- Anthropic's rollout switch must also be on for your account. `ruflo mods doctor` reports its state, and it flipped during development.
- The mods API is early access and may change.

### Verified
- **Registry:** latest, alpha and v3alpha are 3.50.0 for all three packages.
- **Fresh install:** `npm i ruflo@3.50.0` gives `ruflo v3.50.0`; `mods install`, `status` and `doctor` work and write only inside the project.
- **Plugin tests:** engine-kit tests pass on 2.1.287 (ruflo-mods 16/16, ruflo-swarm 38/38, ruflo-ruos 3/3), and `claude plugin validate` passes for all three.
- **Release integrity:** the witness passes 117/117 on linux, macos and windows, and the signed helper manifest verifies.

Coordinated with the ruOS lane: `@cognitum/ruos` 0.3.0 ships the ruOS mod and the jobs API clients.

Gist: https://gist.github.com/ruvnet/aede145f8e730eb434e14decbb3f10a1

key_changes: 新增 ruflo 作为 Claude Code 插件的支持（opt-in 模式），可通过 `ruflo mods install | uninstall | status | doctor | sync-policy` 和 `ruflo init --mods` 命令管理
推出 ruflo-mods 插件：提供进程内 prompt 路由（平均 0.045ms，远快于原生的 18.2ms）、tool.check 策略校验、编辑学习信号、成本预算阶梯和状态栏等功能
推出 ruflo-swarm 面板插件 0.3.0：实时显示各 agent 的读写活动、拓扑结构、任务板、成本和 token 使用情况，并支持通过 ruflo CLI 进行操作
推出 ruflo-ruos 插件：支持在自有 ruOS 云桌面上运行 swarm agents，仅使用租户认证的 fleet MCP 和安全传输通道
推出 ruflo-plugin-creator 0.3.0：提供 create-mod 技能和模板用于搭建受治理的 mods
ai_summary.summary_cn: ruflo v3.50.0 将 ruflo 集成到 Claude Code mods API 中，允许插件以进程内 TypeScript 函数的形式直接挂钩引擎，而非通过 shell 命令。本次升级为 opt-in 模式，经典 hooks 仍是默认和行为回退；同时推出了三个新插件（ruflo-mods、ruflo-swarm、ruflo-ruos）和一个 mod 创建工具，提供了更快速的路由、实时 agent 可视化面板以及云桌面 swarm 运行支持。需要 Claude Code 2.1.287 或更新版本才能完全启用 mods 功能。

This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of August 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.9.7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.9.7)

## 2026.8.35

### Highlights

- **GPT-6.1 Sol support:** add the current Sol model across OpenAI routing, discovery, reasoning, harness, and Reef guard-model boundaries. (#161400, #162955)
- **Safer updates and recovery:** preserve plugin settings, prevent duplicate Gateways, handle pnpm package updates without terminal failures, and retain plugin inventory through migration. (#160344, #160193, #161920, #161485) Thanks @EndeavorPioneer, @grtninja, @alkor2000, @xilopaint, and @aniruddhaadak80.
- **Reliable agent completion:** preserve complete delegated and CLI answers, release suspended child capacity, recover full cron output, and prevent failed requests from consuming steered questions. (#162843, #162368, #160520, #162439) Thanks @zyz619963502zyz, @holgergruenhagen, @armstrongsam25, @davidcittadini, @jayzhou2309, and @obviyus.
- **Security and ownership hardening:** keep secret-store kinds stable during rotation, restore admitted secret-egress execution, and retain explicit cron tool allowlists while repairing stale automatic snapshots. (#160926, #160760, #162432) Thanks @zachisfine, @yetval, @VACInc, and @obviyus.
- **Channel and integration reliability:** repair Gmail and IMAP watchers, Matrix direct mappings, Telegram progress, remote MCP startup, and managed llama.cpp startup on clean Windows hosts. (#161503, #160413, #161727, #161546, #162376, #163093) Thanks @obviyus, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @Ayushdevo, @addyCooks, @VACInc, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @RomneyDa.

### Changes

### Release readiness review (v0.23.0 -> TARGET 0a5a08b21cd44808d73e8a9e732212dd33b3690d)

This is a release readiness report done by `$final-release-review` skill.

### Diff

https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/compare/v0.23.0...0a5a08b21cd44808d73e8a9e732212dd33b3690d

### Release intent

- Review mode: final candidate
- Intended release: patch, 0.23.1
- Minimum required release type: patch
- Versioning verdict: compatible

### Release call

**🟢 GREEN LIGHT TO SHIP** this exact candidate. No concrete release-blocking regression was identified. Human approval and normal repository protections still apply.

### Scope summary

- 28 files changed (+622/-42): release automation, test fixtures, integration/example tooling, and release metadata.
- The clean candidate contains current main `a575a6e637feb9aea1b591237b007dd4991ddfba` plus only six release-owned metadata files. Package, lockfile, manifest, source version and API baseline agree on 0.23.1. Snapshot source `b31b9f8d13d49142a64f8873f2cc2ee40441a795` is an ancestor of the candidate.
- Relative to v0.23.0, SDK runtime source changes only its version string. API snapshot content, dependencies, Python support and persisted schemas are unchanged.

### Risk assessment (ordered by impact)

1. **First PyPI publication of the 0.23 series includes earlier migration requirements**
   - Risk: **🟢 LOW** with the previously reviewed migration paths. Users upgrading from 0.22.3 receive the 0.23.0 behavior changes as well as this patch.
   - Evidence: PyPI has neither 0.23.0 nor 0.23.1. The 0.23.0 release assessment in #5226 covers strict tools, approval restoration, encrypted history, resource limits, voice defaults and provider changes; this candidate does not alter those runtime paths.
   - Files: `CHANGELOG.md`, `src/agents/version.py`; unchanged 0.23.0 runtime contracts assessed in #5226.
   - Action: Carry forward the 0.23.0 migration guidance in the 0.23.1 announcement, particularly explicit strict-tool parameters, fresh legacy approvals, trusted encrypted-history import, resource-limit overrides and the explicit prior voice-model override.

2. **Release checks recover without changing package behavior**
   - Risk: **🟢 LOW**. Test-loop initialization and required-check ownership are corrected while publication authorization remains intact.
   - Evidence: OS mocks are installed after event-loop initialization and restored before teardown. Authorized review events rerun the current PR-triggered readiness check instead of replacing or cancelling it. Source validation, native human approval, isolated builds and OIDC publishing remain unchanged.
   - Files: `tests/sandbox/test_unix_local_user_file_io.py`, `.github/scripts/release_automation.py`, `.github/workflows/release-readiness-refresh.yml`, `.github/workflows/release-readiness.yml`.
   - Action: Submit the exact-head human approval, allow readiness to refresh, merge through normal protections, and verify the publisher and uploaded provenance.

3. **External-provider coverage now requires explicit maintainer intent**
   - Risk: **🟢 LOW** with an existing opt-in path. Default integration and automatic example runs no longer implicitly select the affected external-provider cases.
   - Evidence: Integration bootstrap resets inherited enable flags, removes the listed external-provider credentials by default, and rejects external model overrides without opt-in. External cases are deselected by default; automatic examples use the expanded skip list. Manual example selection remains available.
   - Files: `.github/scripts/run_integration_tests.py`, `integration_tests/conftest.py`, `Makefile`, `examples/run_examples.py`, `integration_tests/README.md`.
   - Action: Use `make integration-tests-providers-external`, adding `-- --all` when direct-provider coverage is intended. Do not interpret default coverage as external-provider validation.

### Documentation coverage (non-blocking)

- Coverage source: current open PRs #5279 and #4828; #4828 head `fa2c43bc9e252c75d76d60c06959a725f1dc0205` has no release documentation coverage. No separate open `docs/` PR was found after inspecting the current file lists.
- Status: covered for this patch's maintainer workflows; partially covered for inherited 0.23.0 migrations.
- Covered obligations: `.github/RELEASING.md` explains readiness refresh and retry; `integration_tests/README.md` explains explicit external-provider execution and credential behavior.
- Post-release suggestions: retain the detailed follow-ups from #5226. In particular, update `docs/voice/quickstart.md` and `docs/voice/pipeline.md` with the new default and explicit prior-model override; `docs/human_in_the_loop.md` with legacy approval/MCP restoration guidance; `docs/tools.md` and `docs/realtime/transport.md` with callback/message limits and overrides; `docs/sessions/encrypted_session.md` with trusted plaintext migration through `add_items()`. The inherited MCP, sandbox, tracing and SQLAlchemy guidance remains part of that separate documentation handoff.
- Publication timing: coordinate inherited migration documentation with 0.23.1 availability on PyPI.

### Notes

- This report reviews v0.23.0 through the pinned candidate and reuses the earlier assessment only for unchanged inherited runtime paths. It is not a claim that 0.23.0 was published on PyPI.
- Normal exact-head CI/package checks are successful. Release readiness fails solely for the missing human approval expected at this handoff. No live API calls or routine local CI rerun were needed for this assessment.
- The separate experimental backfill changes are absent from this candidate.
- PyPI registry binding and the eventual uploaded artifact provenance require publication-time verification. A green source assessment does not prove publication succeeded.
- Any new candidate head invalidates this approval body.

key_changes: 新增可配置的 MCP 列表页数量限制（#5133）
新增沙箱 Docker 删除保护和内存整合轮次配置（#5116、#5135）
新增会话加密历史扫描预算，增强会话数据安全性（#5118）

ai_summary.summary_cn: v0.23.0 是一个功能与修复并重的版本，新增了 MCP 列表页限制配置、沙箱 Docker 删除保护、内存整合轮次配置和加密历史扫描预算等多项新能力。同时包含大量核心模块安全性修复，涵盖敏感信息脱敏、WebSocket 握手重试、工具状态隔离以及语音流式转录的稳定性改进，并伴随多项依赖升级。整体以增量功能和安全加固为主，不涉及破坏性 API 变更。

## [1.20.0] - 2026-10-02

### Added
- **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**: Host native workflows over Foundry Responses and Foundry Invocations ([#8947](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8947), [#8966](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8966))
- **agent-framework-duckdb**, **agent-framework-sql-server**, **agent-framework-typesafe**: Add DuckDB and SQL Server native vector-store connectors and the TypeSafe AI connector ([#8675](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8675), [#8686](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8686), [#8592](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8592))
- **agent-framework**, **agent-framework-core**: Add response-stream gates and buffering, session-scoped file-access isolation, an `AgentExecutor` checkpoint-state `TypedDict`, and opt-in `FunctionInvocationContext` injection for skill scripts ([#8829](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8829), [#8542](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8542), [#8284](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8284), [#8749](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8749))
- **agent-framework-foundry**, **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**, **agent-framework-openai**: Add native computer-use support to Responses clients and Foundry project embeddings ([#8751](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8751), [#8454](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8454))
- **agent-framework-azure-ai-search**: Support `knowledge_source_params` in `AzureAISearchContextProvider` ([#8673](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8673))
- **agent-framework-mongodb**, **samples**: Add a MongoDB agent RAG sample ([#8725](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8725))

### Changed
- **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**: [BREAKING] Redesign Foundry hosting around request-scoped agent factories, persistent sandbox-isolated sessions, parsed and durable Invocations runs, and configurable Responses history, background execution, and options ([#8372](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8372), [#8593](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8593), [#8741](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8741), [#8794](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8794), [#8894](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8894))
- **agent-framework-core**: Harden approval and MCP runtime context handling, treat matched function results as terminal, require session-backed local approvals, and fail closed when approval bindings or agent-tool approvals cannot be resolved ([#8579](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8579), [#8589](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8589), [#8750](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8750), [#8780](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8780), [#8527](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8527))
- **agent-framework-declarative**: [BREAKING - experimental] Align workflow state attribute lookup, bound PowerFx state construction, normalize workflow HTTP request URLs, and preserve expression results in `SendActivity` output ([#8893](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8893), [#8511](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8511), [#8588](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8588), [#8509](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8509))
- **agent-framework-gemini**, **agent-framework-core**: [BREAKING] Add Gemini Embedding 2 and vector task options, use the `GOOGLE_*` settings namespace, and support operation-specific embedding options in shared vector APIs ([#8798](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8798))
- **agent-framework-ag-ui**, **agent-framework-core**: Treat matched tool results as terminal; make disconnected AG-UI runs durable, emit `RUN_STARTED` before execution when IDs are supplied, and isolate custom approval-state namespaces ([#8579](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8579), [#8672](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8672), [#8807](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8807), [#8714](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8714))
- **agent-framework**, **agent-framework-core**: Bound the `all` integration set to the current release cohort to avoid pip resolver backtracking, and support `msgspec` 0.22 for Python 3.15 installations
- **agent-framework-a2a**, **agent-framework-anthropic**, **agent-framework-azure-contentunderstanding**, **agent-framework-azure-cosmos-memory**, **agent-framework-bedrock**, **agent-framework-claude**, **agent-framework-copilotstudio**, **agent-framework-declarative**, **agent-framework-devui**, **agent-framework-foundry**, **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**, **agent-framework-github-copilot**, **agent-framework-hosting**, **agent-framework-hosting-responses**, **agent-framework-hosting-telegram**, **agent-framework-mem0**, **agent-framework-purview**, **agent-framework-redis**: Add missing `py.typed` markers and enforce their presence in package checks ([#8823](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8823))
- **agent-framework-bedrock**: Forward Converse guardrail and additional-model-request options, send user images, and stream through ConverseStream ([#8680](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8680), [#8683](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8683), [#8685](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8685))
- **agent-framework-chatkit**: Support structured input and generated-image conversion ([#8843](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8843), [#8844](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8844))
- **agent-framework-orchestrations**: Create Magentic managers per workflow, optionally disable return-to-previous handoff routing, gate sequential output on approval, and validate generated handoffs before routing ([#8581](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8581), [#8639](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8639), [#8595](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8595), [#8587](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8587))
- **agent-framework-redis**: Allow `RedisHistoryProvider` to borrow a Redis client, clarify context-retrieval scope, and declare the current Python `<3.15` limit imposed by `redisvl` ([#8883](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8883), [#8584](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8584))
- **agent-framework-postgres**, **agent-framework-hyperlight**: Restore supported Python 3.15 dependency resolution ([#8505](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8505))
- **agent-framework-foundry**: Require Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry 1.8.10 for trace propagation and support Azure AI Projects through 2.7 ([#8512](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8512), [#8751](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8751))
- **agent-framework-hyperlight**, **agent-framework-monty**: Clarify CodeAct guest-package installation and host-network access ([#8781](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8781))
- **tests**: Refresh root and Lab development dependencies, type checkers, transitive security dependencies, and lockfiles; require Python 3.15 checks and add bounded Windows 3.14 meta-package install coverage ([#8505](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8505), [#8612](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8612), [#8650](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8650), [#8727](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8727), [#8942](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8942), [#8945](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8945))
- **docs**, **samples**: Cross-reference security patterns, clarify file-search retrieval scope, improve local-shell filtering guidance, and correct README instructions ([#8726](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8726), [#8591](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8591), [#8766](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8766), [#8822](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8822))

### Fixed
- **agent-framework-openai**: Isolate OpenAI metadata defaults from Azure-routed clients ([#8969](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8969))
- **agent-framework-core**: Apply MCP security labels before dynamically discovered and progressively disclosed tools become callable ([#8972](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8972))
- **agent-framework-core**: Reduce response-stream hot-path overhead and avoid loading tool-approval middleware for agent runs without middleware ([#8971](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8971))
- **agent-framework-core**: Preserve functional-workflow replay identity, scope invocation arguments and activity IDs to workflow runs, deduplicate fan-out targets, propagate nested cancellation arguments, and support orchestration checkpoint deserialization ([#8887](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8887), [#8596](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8596), [#8549](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8549), [#8739](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8739), [#8602](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8602), [#8723](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8723))
- **agent-framework-core**: Preserve repeated history turns, compaction through middleware rewrites, checkpoint dictionary subclasses, response metadata, annotations, native vector keys, integer precision, and boolean set values ([#8800](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8800), [#8671](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8671), [#8519](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8519), [#8464](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8464), [#8701](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8701), [#8535](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8535), [#8637](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8637), [#8681](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8681))
- **agent-framework-core**: Improve MCP skill archive and resource validation, stop failed MCP lifecycle owners, distinguish missing tool arguments from parse failures, settle fatal unknown calls, and omit absent MCP prompt-argument descriptions ([#8937](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8937), [#8690](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8690), [#8755](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8755), [#8609](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8609), [#8640](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8640), [#8733](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8733))
- **agent-framework-core**: Run response-stream cleanup hooks after transform failures, report unreadable history records and actionable file-write errors, handle concurrent file-store deletion, and preserve Unicode display paths ([#8774](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8774), [#8778](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8778), [#8710](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8710), [#8457](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8457), [#8630](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8630))
- **agent-framework-core**: Coerce typed environment settings, detect postponed middleware annotations, preserve `Any` compatibility and structured approval output, and expose validated agent lifecycle methods ([#8926](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8926), [#8648](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8648), [#8660](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8660), [#8548](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8548), [#8709](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8709))
- **agent-framework-core**: Preserve usage-detail copies, skip empty prepended instructions, reject ambiguous media inputs and empty mode sets, surface switch-condition errors, validate tool-evaluation keys, and copy only requested vector-search pages ([#8613](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8613), [#8524](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8524), [#8557](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8557), [#8536](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8536), [#8490](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8490), [#8560](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8560), [#8544](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8544))
- **agent-framework-core**: Treat missing streamed text deltas as empty and avoid spurious warnings for staged approvals ([#8699](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8699), [#8895](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8895))
- **agent-framework-core**, **agent-framework-openai**: Close Chat Completions SDK streams deterministically when consumers stop early or stream transforms fail ([#8773](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8773))
- **agent-framework-ag-ui**, **agent-framework-openai**: Preserve Responses API citations through AG-UI, convert image inputs, read tool-call IDs from result events, and allow text events with dictionary JSON schemas ([#8948](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8948), [#8737](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8737), [#8734](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8734), [#8604](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8604))
- **agent-framework-openai**: Accept the registered `audio/mpeg` media type for MP3 input in both OpenAI chat clients ([#8787](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8787))
- **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**: Harden Responses request parsing, sandbox isolation, toolbox context and feature headers, cancellation completion, incomplete finish reasons, and OAuth consent-origin handling ([#8899](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8899), [#8717](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8717), [#8722](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8722), [#8565](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8565), [#8478](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8478), [#8713](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8713))
- **agent-framework-foundry**, **agent-framework-openai**: Preserve Foundry background local-tool replay and empty hosted-MCP allowlists ([#8670](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8670), [#8576](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8576))
- **agent-framework-openai**, **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**, **agent-framework-tools**: Preserve shell outcome fidelity, route unmarked shell calls to registered local executors, and improve shell and file-access validation ([#8934](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8934), [#8720](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8720), [#8507](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8507))
- **agent-framework-anthropic**, **agent-framework-bedrock**, **agent-framework-gemini**, **agent-framework-ollama**: Send single stop strings as lists; avoid mutating Anthropic caller metadata and response schemas ([#8736](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8736), [#8816](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8816), [#8735](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8735))
- **agent-framework-ollama**: Preserve zero embedding `keep_alive`, include tool names on result messages, and reject non-image data instead of sending it as an image ([#8928](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8928), [#8815](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8815), [#8917](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8917))
- **agent-framework-declarative**: Evaluate `autoSend` expressions before output, avoid repeated workflow-reference traversal, and include `InvokeAzureAgent` input arguments in agent text ([#8508](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8508), [#8510](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8510), [#8547](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8547))
- **agent-framework-orchestrations**: Parse fenced JSON from group-chat managers and preserve multimodal user content during handoff ([#8850](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8850), [#8551](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8551))
- **agent-framework-github-copilot**: Forward function-invocation keyword arguments to agent tools ([#8868](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8868))
- **agent-framework-a2a**: Keep streaming session state current and accept integer agent timeouts ([#8646](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8646), [#8516](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8516))
- **agent-framework-azure-cosmos**, **agent-framework-azure-documentdb**: Preserve nulls in negated Cosmos equality filters and omit nulls from DocumentDB membership filters ([#8771](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8771), [#8654](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8654))
- **agent-framework-redis**: Preserve memory-vectorizer data types and repeated history turns ([#8629](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8629), [#8800](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8800))
- **agent-framework-hosting-telegram**: Ignore commands addressed to other bots ([#8803](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8803))
- **agent-framework-hyperlight**: Retain cached tool identities ([#8598](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8598))
- **agent-framework-tools**: Support short Docker command flags ([#8644](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8644))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/compare/python-1.19.0...python-1.20.0

key_changes: agent-framework-foundry-hosting 进行破坏性重构，改为基于请求作用域的 agent 工厂和持久化沙箱隔离会话，支持解析的 Invocations 运行及可配置的 Responses 历史记录
引入多个新连接器：DuckDB/SQL Server 原生向量存储连接器、TypeSafe AI 连接器，以及 Foundry Responses/Invocations 的主机原生工作流支持
agent-framework-gemini 与 core 破坏性变更：新增 Gemini Embedding 2 和向量任务选项，改用 GOOGLE_* 设置命名空间
agent-framework-declarative 实验性破坏性变更：统一工作流状态属性查找、PowerFx 状态构造并对齐 SendActivity 输出
大量核心修复：MCP 安全标签、响应流性能优化、OpenAI 元数据隔离、工作流回放/去重/取消传播等
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本包含多项破坏性变更，核心是 agent-framework-foundry-hosting 的全面重构、Gemini 设置命名空间切换以及 declarative 工作流状态对齐。同时新增了 DuckDB、SQL Server 和 TypeSafe AI 等多个连接器，以及 Foundry 原生工作流托管、计算机使用等新功能。此外修复了大量 MCP 安全、工作流回放、流式处理和各类连接器相关的缺陷，并提升了 Python 3.15 兼容性。

ai_summary.summary_cn: Turborepo v2.11.7 是一个补丁版本，主要包含两项修复和一个示例更新。修复了 SDKROOT 未被正确传递给仓库任务的问题，以及 Vercel OIDC token 旋转导致 .env.local 缓存输入不必要失效的问题。同时更新了 Vite Module Federation 示例项目。整体变更较为轻微，不涉及破坏性变更。

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本期信号以高影响单仓问题为主，但同时识别出 5 组跨仓库共性问题，其中最突出的是工作流运行时（workflow_runtime）类缺陷——多仓暴露 Windows 路径/glob 处理不当导致的崩溃，以及会话状态（session_state）恢复可靠性问题。安全类（auth_permission）共性问题横跨多个 Agent 平台，涉及配置注入/文件写删除绕过确认等高危缺陷。
global_highlights: 跨仓最高频共性问题（154 处信号）集中在 Windows 下 read-only/glob 非相对模式导致 NotImplementedError 崩溃，波及 40+ 仓库，属 P0 级基础路径处理缺陷
安全类共性问题突出：aider/agentscope/continue 等仓库均报告绕过编辑确认导致的路径穿越与主机代码执行漏洞，且 agent scope 的 Bash 安全护栏可被引号/符号链接/变量拼写绕过，属 P0 高危
会话状态恢复共性问题（37 处信号）在多个 Agent 平台（OpenHands、claude-agent-sdk、langchain/microsoft 系）复现：自动恢复请求被永久抑制或 session 数据在暂停后静默丢失/损坏
流式工具调用协议缺陷跨 agentscope、anthropic SDK、langchain/microsoft 生态共 17 处信号：无参工具恒失败或将失败流误判为成功回复，默认开启的流式路径直接影响大量正常使用场景

top_pain_points.topic: 云端会话在暂停后无法可靠恢复(自动恢复请求被永久抑制)
top_pain_points.summary: 用户回到已暂停的云端会话时,前端只发送一次自动恢复请求,任一瞬态失败(429/499/502)会永久抑制重试直到重载页面;同时在当前路由主动暂停会触发立即自动恢复,产生 pause→resume 竞态导致恢复失败。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 暂停恢复是云端会话的常规生命周期,但一次瞬态失败即可让已暂停会话在整个路由生命周期内不可恢复(需重载),且暂停动作会触发错误的立即恢复竞态,属云端主功能不可靠。

source_issues.evidence: 压缩调用实际消耗 12345 input/678 output tokens 但压缩后 usage 为 None，而普通回复同一 usage 被正确记录；任何基于 usage 的计费/预算/事件监听都会系统性低估成本。

source_issues.title: Session store writes and reads derive project_key differently, so a git-worktree session lists and resumes as empty
source_issues.evidence: worktree 会话 list_sessions_from_store 返回 []，materialize_resume_session 返回 None，resume 后直接启动全新会话，被恢复的历史静默消失，无任何错误。

source_issues.title: A corrupt transcript line aborts import_session_to_store mid-write, leaving a partial session
source_issues.evidence: 单行无法解析的 transcript 中止导入，且较早批次已提交，留下缺最后一条消息的部分会话，query(resume=...) 会静默打开该残缺会话。

source_issues.title: Session rename and tag can silently leave partial JSONL metadata
source_issues.evidence: _try_append 只调用一次 os.write 不检查字节数，短写入留下不完整 JSONL 行但 rename/tag 仍报告成功，后续标题/标签更新可能在读取时丢失。

source_issues.title: Session summary parser skips ordinary user text equal to tool_result
source_issues.evidence: 解析器在解析 JSON 前就匹配字符串 "tool_result"，把普通用户文本误判为工具结果，导致 get_session_info_from_store 返回 None、会话在按摘要派生的路径中丢失。

source_issues.title: listSessions() returns cwd: undefined when the first user message contains a large image
source_issues.evidence: transcript 首行用户消息含 inline base64 截图时 line 长度达 274326 字节，cwd 位于 byte ~274204，超过 64KB 搜索窗口导致 cwd: undefined；claude-agent-acp session/list 跳过无 cwd 条目，ACP 客户端看不到该会话；作者机器上 13 个真实会话被隐藏，即使可正常 --resume。

source_issues.title: `task` tool discards the subagent's token usage, making subagent spend invisible to agent-state accounting
source_issues.evidence: subagent message history is reduced to a single ToolMessage; all usage_metadata dropped. Production run on delegation-heavy agent understated spend ~50% (~$3 reported vs ~$6 actual on a 152-request run); workaround requires bypassing agent state entirely.

source_issues.title: A subagent's model choice overwrites the main agent's after `task`
source_issues.evidence: task copies subagent state keys into parent state, so a subagent router key (model_route) replaces the main agent's; the main agent finishes on the subagent's cheaper model instead of the chosen strong model.

source_issues.title: No-op subagent duplicates inherited custom state with an additive reducer
source_issues.evidence: with state_schema using operator.add, a no-op child that makes no updates leaves facts=['parent-seed','parent-seed']; seed value replayed through child and applied a second time. Non-idempotent reducer state (lists, counters) grows just from delegation.

top_pain_points.topic: 安全问题:打开不可信仓库或特定编辑格式可绕过编辑确认提示,导致路径穿越写文件或主机上执行任意代码
top_pain_points.summary: 两处未修复高危漏洞报告:一种编辑格式可将文件写/删到仓库根目录之外且不被确认提示覆盖(路径穿越+内容/路径由模型控制,可致敏感位置写入和代码执行);aider 启动时自动加载不可信每仓库配置并注入子进程环境,使用户对一个看似只读命令的批准实际执行攻击者代码
aliases: LLM profile 切换丢失凭据
top_pain_points.review_reason: 两处均为面向用户的安全缺陷:打开不可信仓库/编辑操作可绕过 existing confirmation prompt 写入敏感位置或执行主机代码,直接损害用户资产安全与信任。虽然具体 PoC 因协调披露而暂未公开,但所描述场景有明确用户影响证据,故保留。

source_issues.title: Security : an edit format can write and delete files outside the repository root, bypassing the edit-confirmation prompt
source_issues.evidence: 报告者称一种编辑格式可将文件操作导向仓库之外,绕过用户依赖的确认提示,可创建/覆盖任意位置文件并删除仓内原件,评估为 High(路径穿越+确认绕过)

source_issues.title: Security: opening an untrusted repo can turn an approved command into host code execution via auto-loaded per-repo config
source_issues.evidence: aider 自动加载不可信每仓库配置到进程环境并被子进程继承,用户批准一个无害只读命令即可执行攻击者控制代码,评估为 High(主机代码执行)

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Changing LLM model without re-typing the API key wipes the stored key (auth errors on profile switch)
source_issues.evidence: 改变 only 模型而不再输入 API key,保存后 LLM profile 的 api_key 被写成空字符串,切到该 profile 后发消息报 LLMAuthenticationError'You must provide an API key'

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Switching to an OpenRouter profile linked to a provider connection loses API credentials
source_issues.evidence: 切换到引用已保存 provider connection 的 profile 后,下一条消息报 OpenrouterException 401 No cookie auth credentials found,尽管连接里存有 key

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Editing provider-connection base_url does not take effect on next conversation (stale snapshot in settings.json)
source_issues.evidence: 修改 provider connection 的 base_url 后,下次会话仍用 settings.json 里的旧值,报 LiteLLM 405,用户无任何失效提示

source_issues.title: [Bug]: quoted find predicates ("-delete", '-exec') bypass the mutating-find guard and stay auto-ALLOWed
source_issues.evidence: is_read_only_command('find . "-delete"') 返回 True，引号谓词对 check_permissions 的只读快速路径不可见，在危险命令/路径/删除检查之前直接 ALLOW，实现任意命令执行与任意删除而无需确认。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: ReplyBudgetControlMiddleware blocks every tool after the budget, so a structured reply never ends
source_issues.evidence: 预算耗尽后强制 tool_choice=none，而结构化回复只能通过 GenerateStructuredOutput 工具结束，导致回复以 exceed_max_iters 结束且 structured_output=None（默认 55 次调用，54 次在预算花尽之后，成本被放大）。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: WordParser silently drops images embedded inside table cells
source_issues.evidence: 表格单元格内嵌图片被静默丢弃，RAG/提取结果缺失关键视觉内容且无任何警告，用户得到的解析结果与源文档不一致。

source_issues.title: apiBase and model settings are being ignored
source_issues.evidence: 本处对应 #12896：配置了 DeepSeek 的 apiBase 与 model，但 Continue 仍自我报告为 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet'，apiBase/模型配置被忽略，模型身份与上下文错误。

source_issues.title: Error: clientCert not provided to server.
source_issues.evidence: 本处对应 #12805：配置了 ollama 自定义服务的 clientCertificate cert/key（路径存在、curl 可用），但 Continue 请求时未发送客户端证书，服务端 400 'No required SSL certificate was sent'。

top_pain_points.topic: 流式响应的工具调用处理错误，导致无参工具恒失败或失败流被当作成功回复
top_pain_points.summary: 流式路径存在协议处理缺陷：Anthropic/MiniMax 流式工具调用若无参数，输入保持为空串 '' 导致 JSONDecodeError，凡是无参数的工具(内置 TaskList、CompressContext 及 MCP 无参工具)一律失败；OpenAI Responses API 流失败时返回的 response.failed/error 事件被跳过，截断文本被当作已完成回复保存，用户看不到任何错误。两者都属于默认开启的流式路径，直接影响大量正常使用场景。
aliases: 代码解释器文件引用丢失
top_pain_points.review_reason: 流式是这些模型的默认路径，无参工具调用是极常见场景，却恒定失败；失败流又被当作成功完成保存。用户反复遇到工具不执行或拿到被截断的结果且无任何报错，是功能性的反复失败与结果不可信。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: OpenAIResponseModel turns a failed stream into a completed reply
source_issues.evidence: 流中 response.failed/error 事件被跳过，循环正常结束，截断的答案被当作已完成回复保存进 context，无异常抛出，用户得到不完整结果却误以为成功。

source_issues.title: HookEvent names 10 of the CLI's hook events; SessionStartHookSpecificOutput is exported for an event the literal cannot register
source_issues.evidence: 类型检查失败但运行时让 SessionStart 等注册成功，文档与实际行为不一致，用户难以定义符合预期的 hook。

source_issues.title: elicitation and request_user_dialog control requests are answered with an error; supportedDialogKinds and perTaskStopAffordance are never sent
source_issues.evidence: elicitation/request_user_dialog 控制请求被回复 Unsupported control request subtype，且未声明 perTaskStopAffordance 导致中断时后台任务被杀死。

source_issues.title: Late hook completion after Query.close writes twice to closed transport (0.2.163)
source_issues.evidence: 关闭后完成的 hook 会对已关闭传输同时尝试 success 与 error 两次写入，产生未被检索的 CLIConnectionError 任务异常。

source_issues.title: @tool builds an empty input schema, with no error, for an input_schema it does not recognize (typing_extensions.TypedDict on Python 3.11 and later)
source_issues.evidence: Python 3.11 上 typing_extensions.TypedDict 类工具被注册为 {"properties":{},"type":"object"}，无任何警告，工具所有参数静默丢失，agent 无法正确调用。

source_issues.title: MCP TypedDict schemas misclassify Required/NotRequired under postponed annotations
source_issues.evidence: 未来注解下可选参数被当作必填，调用 {"query":"test"} 返回 isError 且 handler 不执行；反过来缺失的必填参数却被接受，工具协议行为错误。

source_issues.title: Cross-version zod schemas crash tools/list in createSdkMcpServer (connected but zero tools)
source_issues.evidence: zod 4.6.5 构建的 z.record() 调用 ctx.deferred.push(...)，但内置 4.4.3 上下文无 deferred 字段，抛出 TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push')；该异常在序列化工具列表时抛出，整个 tools/list 失败，服务器报 connected 但零工具，是静默且难归因的失败。

source_issues.title: fix(mcp): load_mcp_server() connects but never registers ToolSpecs
source_issues.evidence: load_mcp_server() 报告已成功加载 N 个工具,却从不调用 create_mcp_tools()/构建 ToolSpecs,也不失效 available_tools ContextVar 缓存,get_available_tools() 返回过期列表,调用 server.tool_name 抛出 'Tool not found';附最小复现

source_issues.title: [Bug] ACP: edit_file tool calls never get a completed/failed tool_call_update (stay "pending" forever)
source_issues.evidence: deterministic offline repro shows call_write resolves to 'completed' but call_edit stays 'pending' while the file on disk is modified; in one 31-run batch all 29 edit_file calls across 4 runs never closed, and the harness rejected all 4 runs because tool traces never resolved.

source_issues.title: Python: [Bug]: Local shell results are sent to OpenAI as exit 0, even when the command failed or timed out
source_issues.evidence: 命令 exit 3 / 超时 / stderr 全部被包装成 {outcome:{exit,exit_code:0}},stderr 空。模型收到与文本矛盾的成功结果。

signals.topic: aider 在 macOS(arm64) 启动/首次使用时因 scipy 原生扩展 _spropack 加载失败(dlopen __DATA/__thread_bss 报错)而崩溃,无法进入主流程
